title: Invertible relative duality on dualizable objects
statement: Let C be a braided closed monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category] with its canonical evaluation and currying [lem-pod-closed-uncurry-laws]. If T is tensor-invertible, gamma:T ≅ W, and X is dualizable, then [X,W] is dualizable and the canonical braided evaluation-transpose X -> [[X,W],W] is an isomorphism. No scheme, orientation or constructibility datum is required.

source.place: Existing complete source proof; no Lean edit or new hole.

proof.text: The invertible-coefficient internal-Hom comparison identifies [X,W] with [X,1] tensor T. The right side is dualizable because X and T are dualizable. The evaluation-defined comparison for [[X,W],W] identifies it with [[X,1],1]. Uncurrying shows that the relative bidual map followed by this comparison is the coefficient bidual map. The latter is an isomorphism for a dualizable X by its exact dual pairing and triangle identities; cancellation of the comparison proves the relative assertion. This is precisely isDualizable_ihom_obj and isIso_toIhomIhom_of_isDualizable in the cited source.
